# Fanout plan
# src/index.mjs is generated and owned by nobody: stub modules for receipt/tax are on main, so sessions never change it. The coordinator runs `npm run gen` after the last merge.

## currency
owns: src/types.mjs, src/format.mjs, test/cart.test.mjs, test/currency.test.mjs
done: makeProduct(name, priceCents, currency="USD") and formatPrice(cents, currency="USD") per CONTRACT.md; existing cart test updated to cents and passing; npm test passes
test: npm test
regen: npm run gen

## discounts
owns: src/cart.mjs, test/discounts.test.mjs
done: applyCoupon(cart, code) with SAVE10/FLAT5; total(cart) returns integer cents after coupon, per CONTRACT.md; tests build products as literal {name, priceCents, currency} objects
after: currency
test: npm test
regen: npm run gen

## receipt
owns: src/receipt.mjs, test/receipt.test.mjs
done: receipt(cart) implemented using formatPrice and total from the shop; npm test passes
after: currency, discounts
test: npm test
regen: npm run gen

## tax
owns: src/tax.mjs, test/tax.test.mjs
done: taxFor(cart, region) returns integer cents, rounded per CONTRACT.md; npm test passes
after: discounts
test: npm test
regen: npm run gen
